topIssues.title: contracts: Add rootClaim(uint256 l2ChainId) to IDisputeGame
topIssues.author: Inphi
topIssues.body:
In preparation for interop, let's extend the IDisputeGame interface to support the `rootClaim(uint256 l2ChainId) returns (Claim)` method.

This new method will allow users to retrieve the Claim for a particular L2 chain ID. For pre-interop dispute games, this simply returns the root claim.
But for the `SuperDisputeGame.sol`, this should return the claimed output root of the given L2 chain ID. For now, the `SuperDisputeGame.sol` implementation should revert until it can be created with a super root preimage.

topIssues.title: kona: blob fetching failure leads to safe head stall
topIssues.author: joshklop
topIssues.body:
Looks like one of our kona nodes has a [safe head stall](https://optimistic.grafana.net/d/nUSlc3d4k/bedrock-networks?orgId=1&from=now-3h&to=now&timezone=browser&var-network=mainnet-dev&var-node=op-mainnet-kona-geth-a-rpc-1&var-layer=$__all&var-safety=$__all&var-cluster=$__all&var-konaNodes=$__all&refresh=30s). The logs say 

```
WARN blob_source: Failed to fetch blobs: error decoding response body
```

Dugtrigo is showing 404s. See logs from mainnet-l1-b [here](https://optimistic.grafana.net/a/grafana-lokiexplore-app/explore/namespace/mainnet-l1-b/logs?patterns=%5B%5D&from=2025-12-25T01:25:00.000Z&to=2025-12-25T01:59:59.000Z&var-lineFormat=&var-ds=grafanacloud-logs&var-filters=namespace%7C%3D%7Cmainnet-l1-b&var-filters=service_name%7C%3D%7Clighthouse&var-fields=&var-levels=detected_level%7C%3D%7Cunknown&var-metadata=&var-jsonFields=&var-patterns=&var-lineFilterV2=&var-lineFilters=&timezone=browser&var-all-fields=&displayedFields=%5B%5D&urlColumns=%5B%5D&visualizationType=%22logs%22&prettifyLogMessage=false&sortOrder=%22Descending%22&wrapLogMessage=false):

```
WARN Error processing HTTP API request elapsed_ms: 0.737062, status: 404 Not Found, path: /eth/v1/beacon/blobs/13316896, method: GET
```

The log appears even after the node has synced past slot 13316896, which was a [skipped slot](https://beaconscan.com/slot/13316896). Can kona handle skipped slots? (@geoknee also pointed out that this could be due to incomplete reorg handling, it the block in this slot was reorged out)

topPRs.title: feat(dispute): add rootClaim(uint256) for L2 chain ID lookup
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
Add overloaded rootClaim function to IDisputeGame interface that accepts an L2 chain ID parameter. This prepares the dispute game contracts for interop support where claims will need to be retrieved by chain ID.

Pre-interop games (FaultDisputeGame, FaultDisputeGameV2, OPSuccinctFaultDisputeGame) return the existing root claim regardless of chain ID. SuperFaultDisputeGame reverts with
SuperRootPreimageNotSupported until super root preimage support is added.

topPRs.title: batcher: remove isPectra and assume Pectra is always active
topPRs.author: Himess
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Since the Pectra fork happened long ago, we can now assume L1 is always running Pectra. This PR simplifies the batcher code by removing the `isPectra` checks.

## Changes

- Remove `isPectra` parameter from `ChannelConfigProvider.ChannelConfig()`
- Remove `isPectra` parameter from `channelManager.TxData()`
- Simplify `BatchSubmitter.l1Tip()` to no longer return isPectra boolean
- Update `computeSingleCalldataTxCost()` to always use `totalCostFloorPerToken = 10` (Pectra pricing)
- Update all related tests to reflect Pectra-only behavior

## Files Changed

- `op-batcher/batcher/channel_config_provider.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/channel_config.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/channel_manager.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/driver.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/test_batch_submitter.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/channel_config_provider_test.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/channel_manager_test.go`
- `op-batcher/batcher/channel_manager_memory_test.go`

Closes #18479
